meta.method: GET responses from the app's own API (/api/projects, /api/projects/{id}, /api/projects/{id}/area, /api/projects/4/screening-runs/latest/report, /api/projects/4/screening-runs/3/map, /api/projects/4/screening-runs/3/layers/{id}/features, /api/counties, /api/screening-layers/load-status, /api/public/system-info). Enums, form validators, status/finding logic and UI copy read from the app's shipped JS bundle. Derived fields (status, finding, short, cell labels, summary sentence, ring areas) were recomputed with the app's own formulas and checked against the rendered Report page.
notes: project4.layers[].project4.status values: on_site, within_ring_1 (0 to 1/4 mi), within_ring_2 (1/4 to 1 mi), within_ring_3 (1 to 5 mi), not_found, no_data_for_county, not_applicable. The app's internal state key is the first ring index with FeatureCount > 0, or 'none' / 'nodata' / 'na'.
A layer's status is decided by FeatureCount per ring, not quantity. Ring quantities are per ring (donut), not cumulative.
Polygons measure acres covered with overlaps merged; lines measure miles; points measure a count (app copy). On-site share = on-site acres / report acres, polygons only, capped at 100%.
Times are UTC ISO strings from the API; display strings (sourceLine, runLabel, created) are rendered in Pacific time like the app.
Report acres (76.81) differ slightly from the project's stored Acres (76.62); the projects list and setup show 76.6, the Report header shows 76.8 acres.

proximity.question: How far out should the report look?
proximity.intro: Pick one or more distances from the project boundary. Each distance makes a ring, shaped like a donut, that starts where the ring inside it stops, so nothing is counted twice. The report measures every core dataset in each ring and adds a total. Five miles is the largest distance offered.

gaps: No screening-category or layer lookup endpoint exists; themes and layer metadata come from the report response (all 29 layers are returned for every run, including no-data and not-applicable ones).
Theme ids are ScreeningCategoryID; there is no explicit SortOrder, the report returns themes in id order 1-11.
Area definition method enum (AreaDefinitionMethodID 1, 2) is not in the bundle; labels are a guess from which projects use them.
Only one run exists for project 4 (run 3, Complete). Queued, Running and Failed copy comes from the bundle, not a live run; no FailureMessage example exists.
Findings report (assessments) for project 4 returns 204: no draft exists, so section content and Table 1 structure were not observed.
Deep dive has no page or data; it is a locked nav item ('Coming next').

Nearest named features: the report API only returns NearbyFeatures for FAA airports (point layer). Other layers' names (namedFeaturesInRunExtent) come from the map features endpoint and are not distance-sorted; zoning, plan, wetlands and flood layers have no feature names.
Ring outline geometries (map endpoint OutlineGeoJson, ~5 KB each) and full feature geometries were not copied.
Toasts: no Due Diligence specific success/error toast strings were found; errors come from the API.

Composition bars (class mix per row) are derivable from classBreakdown; the colour palette is d3 category10 (#1f77b4, #d62728, #2ca02c, #9467bd, #ff7f0e, #17becf, #8c564b, #e377c2, #bcbd22, #7f7f7f), assigned in class order.
